title: Mixed Consistent PINNs for Elliptic Obstacle Problems with Stability Analysis
summary: We propose a consistent physics-informed neural networks (CPINNs) framework for elliptic obstacle problems formulated as variational inequalities. The method is based on a mixed loss functional that is rigorously aligned with the stability structure of the underlying problem and incorporates obstacle constraints through a consistent treatment of the associated Lagrange multiplier.
